items.title: Jason Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2025
items.q: I always hearken back to this story that I think Max Roach told about Clifford Brown

ctx.x: Is there anything on the bandstand that you’ve either observed or experienced that you find aggravating?

You know at this point in my life just seeing people that aren’t enjoying themselves on the bandstand. That’s probably the most general answer I can give to that. You know or somebody that’s just not giving energy. You know I think energy is something — you can feel it, you can hear it, and you know it when it’s not there. I always hearken back to this story that I think Max Roach told about Clifford Brown where after a concert a lady came up to him, came up to Clifford and said, “You know I don’t know what you…
were having fun up there. You sound like you were a band.” And we need more of that. Every band needs to do that.
